body:
## Problem

`packages/frontend/data/albumArticles/bill-ward.js` claims Bill Ward switched from Pro-Mark sticks to **"Ludwig 2B Hickory"** starting with "Sabotage" (1975), and also claims he used Ludwig 2B Hickory sticks on the 1970 debut album in a separate FAQ/comparison block. Neither claim is supported by ground truth, which documents an unbroken Pro-Mark endorsement from 1970 onward with no switch.

**Fabricated/contradicting lines (file: `packages/frontend/data/albumArticles/bill-ward.js`):**
- Lines 1099-1101 ("Sabotage", 1975): `"model": "Ludwig 2B Hickory"`, notes: "Heavier stick than the Pro-Mark 5A/5B equivalents used on earlier albums..."
- Line 1424 ("Technical Ecstasy", 1976): `"model": "Ludwig 2B Hickory"`, "carried over from Sabotage"
- Line 1748 ("Never Say Die!", 1978): `"model": "Ludwig 2B Hickory"`, "carried over from Technical Ecstasy and Sabotage"
- Line 2488 (FAQ answer re: the 1970 debut album): "...The Ludwig Speed King single pedal and **Ludwig 2B hickory sticks** completed the setup."
- Line 2533 (evolution "then vs now" table): `"then": "Ludwig 2B Hickory"`
- Line 2664 (repeat of the FAQ claim in a companion text block): "...Ludwig Speed King single pedal and Ludwig 2B hickory sticks."

**Contradicts, within the same file:**
- Lines 128-129 (Black Sabbath debut, 1970), 448-449 (Vol. 4, 1972), 775-776 (Sabbath Bloody Sabbath, 1973), and 2825-2826 all correctly state `"brand": "Pro-Mark", "model": "Pro-Mark Standard (5A or 5B equivalent)"` with no documented switch.
- Lines 2940-2941, a separate "then vs now" table in the same file: `"then": "Pro-Mark standard 5A/5B equivalent"` — directly contradicting line 2533's "then: Ludwig 2B Hickory" for what should be the same baseline era.

**Ground truth:** `packages/frontend/data/endorsementNews.js:1035` — `sticks: { brand: 'Pro-Mark', model: 'Standard 5A/5B equivalent', since: '1970' }`; line 1076-1077 — "Played Pro-Mark sticks in a Standard 5A/5B equivalent model from around the 'Paranoid' era onward" (no end date, no switch ever documented). This is distinct from closed #9314 (same claim, but in `gearPriceHistory.js`, a different file) and closed #7446 (same file, but a different fabrication — a "modern gear reference" section wrongly claiming Tama Starclassic/Paiste 2002, not these per-album stick entries).

## Fix

In `packages/frontend/data/albumArticles/bill-ward.js`:
- Lines 1099-1101, 1423-1424, 1747-1748: change `"brand"`/`"model"` from Ludwig 2B Hickory to `"Pro-Mark", "Pro-Mark Standard (5A or 5B equivalent)"`, matching lines 128-129/448-449/775-776. Rewrite the "heavier stick than Pro-Mark... carried over from Sabotage" notes text accordingly (no switch occurred).
- Line 2488 and line 2664: remove "Ludwig 2B hickory sticks" from the debut-album FAQ/text description — replace with "Pro-Mark Standard (5A or 5B equivalent) sticks."
- Line 2533: change `"then": "Ludwig 2B Hickory"` to `"Pro-Mark Standard 5A/5B equivalent"`, resolving the internal contradiction with line 2940's "then" value.

## Verify

1. `grep -n "Ludwig 2B" packages/frontend/data/albumArticles/bill-ward.js` → 0 matches after fix.
2. Confirm lines 2533 and 2940 now agree (both should read "Pro-Mark Standard 5A/5B equivalent" as the "then" baseline).
3. `gh issue list --state all --search "Bill Ward sticks Ludwig"` → confirms distinct from closed #9314 (gearPriceHistory.js) and #7446 (bill-ward.js, but a different drums/cymbals claim) — not a dupe.
4. Cross-check `endorsementNews.js:1035` still shows Pro-Mark since 1970 with no end date.

## Done

Every per-album stick entry in `albumArticles/bill-ward.js` (1970-1978) correctly shows continuous Pro-Mark sticks, with no fabricated Ludwig 2B Hickory switch, and the file's two "then vs now" tables agree with each other.
title: SEO: Bill Ward albumArticles.js fabricates 'Ludwig 2B Hickory' sticks for 1970-1978 — verified continuous Pro-Mark since 1970
